# truenas_iscsi_portal (Resource)

Create a new iSCSI Portal.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `listen` (Attributes List) Array of IP addresses for the portal to listen on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listen))

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional comment describing the portal. Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.
- `tag` (Number) Numeric tag used to associate this portal with iSCSI targets.

<a id="nestedatt--listen"></a>
### Nested Schema for `listen`

Required:

- `ip` (String) IP address for the iSCSI portal to listen on.

Read-Only:

- `port` (Number) TCP port number for the iSCSI portal.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = truenas_iscsi_portal.example
  provider = truenas
  identity = {
    id = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by TrueNAS id
terraform import truenas_iscsi_portal.example 1
```
